title: Simultaneous rescaling of a given flat Artinian coefficient chart
statement: Let k:Type u be a field of characteristic p>0, A:Type v a finitely presented commutative k-algebra, Λ:Type w a Noetherian geometrically regular commutative k-algebra, α:A→Λ a k-algebra homomorphism and q a prime of Λ. Let N>0 with m_(Λ_q)^N contained in the extension of α(singularIdeal k A), d the spanFinrank of m_(Λ_q), a:Fin s→A generators of singularIdeal k A, and c>0. All notions are those of the cited definition nodes. Set n₀=N+d(8c). Fix a surjective polynomial presentation f:k[z₁,…,zᵣ]→A and a flat polynomial chart φ₀:k[y₁,…,yₘ₀]→Λ. Its localized map ψ₀ is flat and the contracted prime extends to the maximal ideal of Λ_q. Suppose its prime-power quotient factors through a local Artinian ring D₀ by a local essentially smooth first map and a flat local second map g₀ to Λ_q/m^n₀, with the commuting quotient diagram and with every α(f(zᵢ)) in the image of g₀, as in [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-solution-modulo]. There exist finite polynomial rings S=k[X_i:i∈Fin d], R=k[Y_i:i∈Fin m], compatible scalar towers S→R→Λ, coefficients ell, and an unpowered parameter list τ:Fin(d+1)→R. The relations image(X_i)^(2N)=sum_j ell(i,j)α(a_j) hold. Every τ_i is zero or image(X_j), belongs to q after mapping, and multiplication by τ_i and τ_i² has identical kernels on R and Λ modulo preceding (8c)-th powers. For J=(τ_i^(8c)), Q=R_(q∩R) and L=Λ_q, there exist n>0, ideals I₀⊂R,K⊂L with m_L^n⊆JL, I₀Q⊆JQ, K⊆JL and I₀L⊆K. There is a local Artinian k-algebra D′ in Type(max u v), with E=D′[T_i], compatible R,R/I₀,S,k algebra structures, E essentially smooth over R/I₀, and scalar tower k→D′→E. There are f₀:A→D′, a flat local ring map g:D′→L/K where L/K is local, unscaled coefficients u₀(i), units δ(i) and coeff(i,j). The S-map sends X_i to C(u₀(i))T_i. Evaluation ev=eval₂Hom(g,i↦g(δ_i)) satisfies ev(algebraMap R E z)=image(z) in L/K. Furthermore g(f₀(x))=image(α(x)) and g(coeff(i,j))=image(ell(i,j)). No c-th-power kernel assertion and no injective polynomial-coefficient evaluation algebra homomorphism is asserted here. Definitions: geometric regularity [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], polynomial algebras [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], essentially smooth ring maps [def-weil-pbc-essentially-smooth-ring-map], prime localizations [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], singular ideals [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal], and quotient algebra maps [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient].

proof.text: Apply the unpadded coefficient-chart construction to obtain the compatible scalar towers, rho, ell, H with HQ generated by rho and HL=m_L, and the coefficient algebra over R/H^n₀ with K=m_L^n₀. This is only the rescaling and coefficient construction, without the appended zero or the powered-ideal conclusions.

Define π=Fin.lastCases 0 rho. The old preceding-parameter ideals coincide with their unpadded versions: a preceding index cannot be the last index. Transfer both quotient kernel equalities. At the last index both scalar operators vanish. The appended zero lies in q and does not change the span of the positive (c*8)-th powers.

For any d-element family b, prove span(b)^(d*e+1)≤span(b_i^e) by induction on d, using the ideal sum-power inequality (I+J)^(n+m)≤I^n+J^m and the singleton-span power identity. The empty family has zero span and the exponent is positive. Since N>0, n₀=N+d(8c)≥d*(c*8)+1. Apply the bound in Q and L. Ideal maps commute with spans and powers; scalar-tower compatibility identifies the two R→L maps. With I₀=H^n₀ and K=m_L^n₀ obtain I₀Q⊆JQ, K⊆JL and I₀L=K.

Use n₀>0 and K⊆JL as the maximal-ideal-power witness. Retain all coefficient algebra structures and evaluation equalities from the unpadded construction and assemble the existential witnesses and conjunctions.

theorem exists_popescu_rescaled_coefficient_chart
    {k : Type u} {A : Type v} {Λ : Type w}
    [Field k] [CommRing A] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k Λ]
    [FinitePresentation k A] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (α : A →ₐ[k] Λ) (q : PrimeSpectrum Λ)
    (hreg : IsGeometricallyRegular k Λ)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hpower : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ N ≤
      (Ideal.map α.toRingHom (singularIdeal k A)).map
        (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)))
    (d : ℕ) (hd : d =
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)).spanFinrank)
    (s : ℕ) (a : Fin s → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = singularIdeal k A)
    (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (r : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin r) k →ₐ[k] A) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (m₀ : ℕ) (φ₀ : MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k →ₐ[k] Λ)
    (ψ₀ : Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) →+*
      Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)
    (hψ₀ : ψ₀.comp (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom))) =
      (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)).comp φ₀.toRingHom)
    (hideal₀ : q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)) =
      (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map
        ((algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)).comp φ₀.toRingHom))
    (hflat₀ : ψ₀.Flat)
    (D₀ : Type (max u w)) [CommRing D₀] [IsLocalRing D₀] [IsArtinianRing D₀]
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
      ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^ (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀]
    (g₀ : D₀ →+* Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal ⧸
      (q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) ^
        (N + d * (8 * c)))
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
      ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
          (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀)]
    [IsLocalHom g₀]
    (hsmooth₀ : EssentiallySmooth
      (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
        ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
          (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
            (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀)
    (hgflat₀ : g₀.Flat)
    (hfactor₀ : (g₀.comp (algebraMap
      (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
        ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
          (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
            (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀)).comp
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
          (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
            (N + d * (8 * c)))) =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((q.asIdeal.map
        (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) ^
          (N + d * (8 * c)))).comp ψ₀)
    (hinc₀ : ∀ i : Fin r, Ideal.Quotient.mk
      ((q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) ^
        (N + d * (8 * c)))
      (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (α (f (MvPolynomial.X i)))) ∈
        Set.range g₀) :
    let S := MvPolynomial (Fin d) k
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (_ : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : Algebra S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
      (_ : IsScalarTower k S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
      (_ : Algebra S Λ) (_ : IsScalarTower S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k S Λ)
      (ell : Fin d × Fin s → Λ) (π : Fin (d + 1) → MvPolynomial (Fin m) k),
      (∀ i, algebraMap S Λ (MvPolynomial.X i) ^ (2 * N) =
        ∑ j : Fin s, ell (i, j) * α (a j)) ∧
      (∀ i, π i = 0 ∨ ∃ j : Fin d,
        π i = algebraMap S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) (MvPolynomial.X j)) ∧
      (∀ i, algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (π i) ∈ q.asIdeal) ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin (d + 1))
        (x : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ Ideal.span
          {y | ∃ j : Fin (d + 1), j.val < i.val ∧ y = π j ^ (c * 8)}),
        π i • x = 0 ↔ π i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin (d + 1))
        (x : Λ ⧸ Ideal.span
          {y | ∃ j : Fin (d + 1), j.val < i.val ∧
            y = algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (π j) ^ (c * 8)}),
        π i • x = 0 ↔ π i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
    let R := MvPolynomial (Fin m) k
    let J := Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin (d + 1) ↦ π i ^ (c * 8)))
    let Q := Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.under R)
    let L := Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal
    letI := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver (q.asIdeal.under R) q.asIdeal
    let JQ := J.map (algebraMap R Q)
    let JL := (J.map (algebraMap R Λ)).map (algebraMap Λ L)
    ∃ (n : ℕ), 0 < n ∧ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L ^ n ≤ JL ∧
      ∃ (I₀ : Ideal R) (K : Ideal L),
        I₀.map (algebraMap R Q) ≤ JQ ∧ K ≤ JL ∧
        (I₀.map (algebraMap R Q)).map (algebraMap Q L) ≤ K ∧
        ∃ (D' : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing D')
          (_ : IsLocalRing D') (_ : IsArtinianRing D') (_ : Algebra k D'),
          let E := MvPolynomial (Fin d) D'
          ∃ (_ : Algebra R E) (_ : Algebra (R ⧸ I₀) E)
            (_ : IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ I₀) E)
            (algSE : Algebra S E) (_ : IsScalarTower S R E)
            (_ : Algebra k E) (_ : IsScalarTower k S E),
            EssentiallySmooth (R ⧸ I₀) E ∧
            ∃ (_ : IsScalarTower k D' E)
              (f₀ : A →ₐ[k] D') (g : D' →+* L ⧸ K)
              (u₀ : Fin d → D') (δ : Fin d → D'ˣ) (coeff : Fin d × Fin s → D'),
              IsLocalRing (L ⧸ K) ∧ IsLocalHom g ∧ g.Flat ∧
              (∀ i : Fin d, @algebraMap S E _ _ algSE (MvPolynomial.X (R := k) i) =
                MvPolynomial.C (σ := Fin d) (u₀ i) * MvPolynomial.X (R := D') i) ∧
              (∀ z : R, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom g (fun i ↦ g (δ i : D'))
                (algebraMap R E z) =
                Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (algebraMap R Λ z))) ∧
              (∀ x, g (f₀ x) =
                Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (α x))) ∧
              (∀ ij, g (coeff ij) =
                Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (ell ij)))
